question: A famous play, 'Abhijnana Shakuntalam' was written by which of the following personalities?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kalidasa**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kalidasa** was a renowned classical Sanskrit author.
 
• He is often considered the greatest poet and dramatist in the Sanskrit language.
 
• **'Abhijnana Shakuntalam'** is one of his most famous works, a play that tells the story of Shakuntala and King Dushyanta.
 
• This play is celebrated for its poetic excellence and has been translated into many languages worldwide.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Kalidasa's other notable works include **'Meghaduta'** and **'Raghuvamsa'**.
 
• His works are marked by their exceptional literary quality and have had a lasting impact on Indian literature and drama.
 
• Kalidasa's contributions have made him a central figure in Indian cultural history, and his plays continue to be performed and studied widely.
